title_en: At Ambasador 2, a business unit for sale with a perfect location and regular floor plan!!!
description_en: At Ambasador 2, a business unit for sale with a perfect location and regular floor plan!!! The environment is located on the 0th floor of a 7-story building and has a total area of ​​66.7 m2. It is organized by 3 separate rooms with glass windows and 1 toilet. The height of the floor is 4 meters and the store has glass facades on both sides, which enables ideal advertising for your business. It is located in a complex built several years ago and has high quality in construction and administration. The property has regular mortgage documentation. Ideal for different types of business such as: coffee bar, call center, dry cleaning, bakery, kindergarten or private nursery, physiotherapy clinic and many other business options.
